<article title="Returns and exchanges">
You can return or exchange unworn items with their tags attached within 60 days of delivery. Start the return from the Orders page, choose the items, and print the prepaid return label. Exchanges for a different size or color ship as soon as the carrier scans your return package.

Items marked final sale, and safety equipment such as climbing hardware, cannot be returned once opened.

Return shipping is free for exchanges. For refunds, a flat 7 dollar label fee is deducted unless the item arrived damaged or we sent the wrong item.

</article>

<request>
partial bundle return
i bought the three-piece cook set bundle. can i return just the pot and keep the rest?

text:
Hi Katarzyna,

Thanks for your question! Based on our returns policy, you can return or exchange unworn items with tags attached within 60 days of delivery by starting the return from your Orders page and selecting the specific items you'd like to return.

However, I don't have details about how our system handles partial bundle returns. A specialist will follow up with you to confirm whether you can return individual pieces from your cook set bundle and what that process would look like.

Best regards,
Fernwood Outfitters Support
